_A_TILE_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: a_tile with a_tile__body. The tile is a flex column, so a_tile__body fills the free height.
_A_TILE_CLICKABLE_DESCRIPTION_: With a_stretched_link on the link the whole tile is clickable, a_bg_{color}_subtle_hover highlights it on hover. Keyboard and screen reader users still get one link with a clear text. Other buttons in the tile need a_position_relative and a_z_index_2.
_A_TILE_COLORS_DESCRIPTION_: The tile is changed with the utility classes: border color (a_border_{color}, a_border_{color}_subtle), shadow (a_shadow_sm / _md / _lg), line style (a_border_style_dashed). The defaults and the corner radius are set with the CSS variables below.
_A_TILE_GRID_DESCRIPTION_: Tiles in a_columns. With a_height_100 all tiles of a row get the same height, a_columns_count_1_mobile shows one tile per row on mobile devices.
_A_TILE_PAGE_DESCRIPTION_: The class a_tile is a box on the surface with a border and rounded corners, e.g. for a summary, a dashboard widget or an item in a list of results. It is CSS only, the parts a_tile__header, a_tile__body, a_tile__footer are optional.
_A_TILE_PARTS_DESCRIPTION_: a_tile__header and a_tile__footer get a subtle background and a line to the body. Use a heading of the right level (h2 … h6) in the header, so the structure of the page stays correct for screen readers.
